description: Page-level SEO analytical feature table for Tunisian sports search demand: 2,032 query-result observations across 213 page, query, semantic, link-graph, commerce, schema, trust, technical and competitor-relative attributes. First domain implementation of the enterprise analytics platform.

lineage.originating_project: Mapping Sports Search Demand and Brand Visibility in Tunisia
notes: SERP position is an observed outcome, not a manipulated variable.
Domain-derived entity does not necessarily mean manufacturer brand.
Statistical association must not be read as causation.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Canonical page URL as collected from the search result.

attributes.name: query
attributes.description: Search query that produced the observation.

attributes.name: domain
attributes.description: Registered domain of the page URL, normalised from the URL host.

attributes.name: word_count
attributes.description: Word count of the extracted main page text.

attributes.name: content_depth
attributes.description: Depth score derived from the page content structure.

attributes.name: internal_pagerank
attributes.description: Internal PageRank estimate over the crawled link graph.

attributes.name: query_page_semantic_similarity
attributes.description: Semantic similarity between the query and the page body.

attributes.name: authority_gap
attributes.description: Page authority minus the competitor benchmark for the same query.

attributes.name: serp_position
attributes.description: Observed organic SERP position (1-10 in the collected environment).

attributes.name: brand_extraction_source
attributes.description: Mechanism used to derive the entity label from the source row.

attributes.name: entity
attributes.description: Domain-derived entity label. Not necessarily a manufacturer brand.

attributes.name: query_word_count_calc
attributes.description: Token count of the query string, recomputed by the platform.

attributes.name: rank_group_robust
attributes.description: Robust SERP position grouping used for sensitivity checks.

attributes.name: rank_score
attributes.description: Normalised rank signal used by the visibility model.

attributes.name: demand_score
attributes.description: Temporal demand component. Neutral while no usable Google Trends observations exist.

attributes.name: demand_score_norm
attributes.description: Rescaled demand component in [0, 1]; neutral (0.5) when unavailable.

attributes.name: demand_score_adjusted
attributes.description: Demand component after external adjustments. Unavailable in this dataset.

attributes.name: demand_component_available
attributes.description: False when no empirical temporal demand observations were available.

attributes.name: entity_visibility
attributes.description: Entity-level visibility signal aggregated from its observations.

attributes.name: svtp_score
attributes.description: Search Visibility Trend Proxy: an externally observable rank/entity visibility proxy, not Search Console performance.

attributes.name: page_trend
attributes.description: Balanced binary label derived from the SVTP distribution.

attributes.name: trend_mean
attributes.description: Temporal demand summary. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_median
attributes.description: Temporal demand summary. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_recent
attributes.description: Temporal demand summary. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_historical
attributes.description: Temporal demand summary. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_growth
attributes.description: Temporal demand growth. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_slope
attributes.description: Temporal demand slope. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_volatility
attributes.description: Temporal demand volatility. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_peak
attributes.description: Temporal demand peak. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_min
attributes.description: Temporal demand minimum. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: trend_n_obs
attributes.description: Count of usable demand observations. Zero in this dataset.

attributes.name: trend_level_norm
attributes.description: Normalised demand level. Neutral while demand is unavailable.

attributes.name: trend_growth_norm
attributes.description: Normalised demand growth. Neutral while demand is unavailable.

attributes.name: trend_score
attributes.description: Composite demand score. Neutral while demand is unavailable.

attributes.name: related_trend_score
attributes.description: Related-query demand score. Not populated: no usable Google Trends observations.

attributes.name: tiktok_engagement_mean
attributes.description: Social engagement signal. Optional external demand input.

attributes.name: tiktok_engagement_max
attributes.description: Social engagement signal. Optional external demand input.

attributes.name: tiktok_video_count
attributes.description: Social content volume signal. Optional external demand input.

attributes.name: tiktok_adjustment
attributes.description: Social adjustment factor applied to the demand component.

attributes.name: CONTENT_EXPANSION_REFRESH_action_score
attributes.description: Transparent prioritisation score for the content expansion/refresh action family.

attributes.name: QUERY_PAGE_ALIGNMENT_action_score
attributes.description: Transparent prioritisation score for the query-page alignment action family.

attributes.name: METADATA_SNIPPET_action_score
attributes.description: Transparent prioritisation score for the metadata/snippet action family.

attributes.name: INTERNAL_AUTHORITY_action_score
attributes.description: Transparent prioritisation score for the internal authority action family.

attributes.name: COMMERCE_SCHEMA_TRUST_action_score
attributes.description: Transparent prioritisation score for the commerce/schema/trust action family.

attributes.name: TECHNICAL_INDEXABILITY_action_score
attributes.description: Transparent prioritisation score for the technical indexability action family.

attributes.name: primary_action
attributes.description: Highest scoring action family for the observation.

attributes.name: primary_action_score
attributes.description: Score of the highest scoring action family.

attributes.name: secondary_action
attributes.description: Second highest scoring action family for the observation.

attributes.name: action_priority
attributes.description: Heuristic priority band (High/Medium/Low). A prioritisation heuristic, not a causal claim.
